'''Victor Grieves''' was an [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Investigations/Legends|Investigations]] [[Specialist/Legends|Specialist]]. He joined the ISB directly from [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]] at the age of 27 and was assigned to the Investigations arm mere weeks before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. After that, he operated with Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governors]] throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], often bringing warning of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] attacks weeks before the attack would even be scheduled to take place.

Even though he missed the glory days of the Empire when he was well-equipped and well supported, Grieves loved the dangers of operating independently. He sometimes considered leaving Imperial service entirely and perhaps becoming an independent spy or even [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. Grieves was last seen operating in the [[Rintonne system/Legends|Rintonne system]] and was suspected to be working with Imperial Governor [[Serdif Tount]].
